propositions: CLI facade reconstructs command identity through 19 overlapping frozensets and lacks a single source of truth for parser definitions and help text
Twenty-one intercept-only commands lack canonical help and report as unknown to 'rebar help <command>' while handler-owned --help is inconsistent and can execute work
All command grammars must be built by the same side-effect-free stdlib argparse factory used at runtime and build-time to eliminate parser/help drift
Generated package-help and overview bytes must be byte-current and runtime-authoritative, committed before operation/config/mount boundaries, ensuring help paths never compose an operation

Parser migration and artifact generation must complete for all command families before execution cutover, with compatibility contracts preserving exact aliases and hidden/retired spellings like jira-onboard and purge-bridge
Optional mode and backend capabilities must be registered separately from routes without eager optional imports, supporting error/unavailable/abstain/fallback postures
